name: Caisra Box
description: The agent's computer: a remote sandbox the engine drives as a sandbox backend, brokered by the Caisra server.

brokerBaseUrl.description: Caisra server that brokers the box. The E2B credential lives there and never reaches this machine.

accessToken.description: Desktop access token presented to the broker as a bearer.

template.description: Box template to start. Absent, the broker picks its default.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for broker calls. Default 120000.
